code: # 1. Reshape for Matrix comparison_matrix <- combined_data %>%   pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Value, values_fill = 0)  cx_compare <- as.data.frame(comparison_matrix[, -1]) rownames(cx_compare) <- comparison_matrix$Adverse_Event  # 5.
